backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only the PIT filing date from the EDGAR form index and signal-date OHLCV available after the close. The signal day is the first trading day on or after the filing date. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.sec_event_provenance: EDGAR quarterly form indexes 2024Q4-2026Q2; SCHEDULE 13G non-amendment rows; accessions resolving to exactly one public issuer ticker through data/reference/sec_company_tickers.json; accessions resolving to zero or multiple public tickers dropped; archive-first initiation per issuer CIK.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus experiment-local SEC 13G passive-stake paper overlay

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: archive-first non-amended SCHEDULE 13G filings that map to exactly one public issuer ticker may identify passive or institutional accumulation candidates. The fixed policy tests whether those candidates add next-open default-off paper EV after liquidity, price, history, core-overlap, top-1/day, and cooldown guards.

2_history_check.difference: 13G is neither an activist 13D retry nor an insider Form4 cluster. It tests a broader passive/institutional ownership disclosure surface using issuer CIK ticker mapping from the EDGAR index.
2_history_check.exp-20260609-025: Form4 liquidity-cost-cluster purchase was rejected because the qualified sample had only two trades, both in mid_weak.
2_history_check.exp-20260612-015: SEC 13D activist initiation was rejected: aggregate EV/PnL fell and all three windows regressed under the same replay style.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Pass only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no unacceptable window, drawdown, survival, trade-count, or concentration regression occurs, and the accepted distribution-day comparator is beaten. Even if positive, this remains lead-only until shared helper/daily parity work exists.

interpretation: The SEC 13G passive-stake source was rejected under the standard three-window protocol and current accepted distribution-day comparator.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different 13G semantics, such as parsed beneficial-owner identity, stake size, percent-change, 13G item category, or closed forward replacement-value rows from a shared daily helper. Do not sweep liquidity, price, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on the same frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping liquidity, price, history, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, notional, or ambiguity thresholds, by re-admitting 13G/A amendments, or by treating reporting-owner CIKs as issuer tickers on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs parsed 13G documents with holder identity, stake percentage, item category, change from prior filing, or a shared daily helper that can generate closed forward replacement-value rows.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The fixed 13G passive-stake bundle failed Gate 4. The most likely reasons are that 13G filings are annual/batch and often stale by the filing date, issuer-level first-in-archive events lose holder-level information, and the liquid momentum/core-overlap envelope admits mostly already-priced large-cap ownership confirmations rather than fresh edge.

prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism: non-amended SCHEDULE 13G filings can reveal large passive or institutional ownership stakes that may keep supporting liquid leaders after disclosure. The source is free EDGAR metadata and has more breadth than the rejected 13D/Form4 ownership scouts. Main disconfirmer: 13G filings are often stale annual batch reports, so next-open paper entries may see no fresh edge.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper builds the same SCHEDULE 13G events from the daily EDGAR index in production and matches the historical replay output.
production_impact.private_replay_scout_escape_reason: The SCHEDULE 13G event archive is created from local EDGAR form-index files inside this experiment; no shared daily helper or production daily-index fetcher exists yet. A positive result is lead-only until the same issuer mapping, ambiguity drop, dedupe, liquidity gates, overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, costs, hold, and cooldown run in shared historical replay and daily default-off snapshots.
